narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran exactly the same. In month {fork_month}, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}, and {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part that same month. From there the ghost's money sat above yours for {ghost_ahead_months} months. The layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the month the two lives stood furthest apart, with the ghost holding {widest_gap}. At month {end_month}, the ghost's cushion against a stretch with no pay was {safety_gap}. It finished with {net_worth_gap}.
